<thought>To identify the compound we need more structural clues. The ¹³C NMR shows a carbonyl (~167 ppm), two aromatic/sp² carbons (≈144 ppm and 130 ppm), and several aliphatic carbons (≈35 ppm and 20‑22 ppm). The mass spectrum gives a molecular ion at m/z 141.115, which is consistent with a [M+H]⁺ of a neutral mass ≈140.1 Da. This suggests a formula around C₇H₈O₃ (exact mass 140.047 Da, [M+H]⁺ 141.055 Da, close to the observed value).  

To confirm the number of aromatic protons and the presence of any OH or CH₃ groups, I will obtain the ¹H NMR spectrum of the sample.</thought>
